doc.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023

title: Kodachrome album and remembered personnel
summary: He was on the Kodachrome album and recalls Steve Gadd, Richard Davis, Hubert Laws, Jerome Richardson and others.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Have you ever been in a car and a Paul Simon tune comes on and you go, “Oh yeah, I was on that”?

It didn’t happen in the car but I’ll tell you what the tunes that I was on were on the “Kodachrome” album. So I was at — this community that I live in they had a guy come in the other night and sing tunes and play guitar. And I turned to the woman next to me and I said, “I was on that album.” So not in a car but in another situation.
I love that. I love the outtro at the end of “Kodachrome” man, that thing is rockin’. There’s that piano part [scats]. Who was that?
I don’t know. I don’t know. The only guys I know were Steve Gadd and I think Cranshaw might have been on one of the dates. Richard Davis, do you know that name Richard Davis the bass player?

Yeah he was on one I think. Hubert Laws. Yeah, and oh, Jerome Richardson. I’m starting to get the picture now, Jerome Richardson, maybe Joe Newman, trumpet player I think Joe was maybe with Basie at one time.
